# Flunked.online — College Survival Tools for Indian Students

> Flunked.online is a free, privacy-first, anti-corporate multi-tool platform built for Indian college students. It provides 19 specialized calculators and estimators designed for campus academics, attendance compliance, placement CTC evaluations, and hostel life.

## Key Principles
- 100% Free & Open: No paywalls, subscription models, or intrusive ads.
- Zero Friction Onboarding: No institutional email mandates, OTP verifications, or passwords.
- Privacy First: Calculations occur client-side in the browser. Inputs are never stored or reported to university administrations.
- Real Academic Standards: Incorporates official university policies (UGC, VTU, Anna University, NMC Medical, BITS Pilani) and placement taxation rules.

## Core Calculators & Tools

### 1. 75% Bunk Attendance Calculator
- URL: https://flunked.online/tools/bunk-calculator
- Purpose: Calculates exactly how many classes a student can safely bunk while staying above a target percentage (e.g. 75%, 80%, 85%), or how many consecutive classes they must attend to recover from a shortage. Supports university-specific preset policies.

### 2. CTC to In-Hand Salary Calculator
- URL: https://flunked.online/tools/ctc-calculator
- Purpose: Deconstructs inflated Indian campus placement CTC letters into actual monthly take-home in-hand pay. Deducts PF, Professional Tax, Income Tax (Old vs New Regime), Gratuity, and amortizes joining bonuses and ESOP vesting periods.

### 3. Official CGPA to Percentage Calculator
- URL: https://flunked.online/tools/cgpa-calculator
- Purpose: Converts university CGPAs into official percentage equivalents using AICTE, CBSE (9.5x), Anna University / VTU (10x), and Mumbai University formulas for placement and higher education eligibility.

### 4. Am I Cooked This Semester?
- URL: https://flunked.online/tools/am-i-cooked
- Purpose: Diagnoses end-semester academic danger level based on attendance shortages, internal marks deficit, assignment pending debt, and remaining weeks until exams.

### 5. Semester Survival Check
- URL: https://flunked.online/tools/semester-survival
- Purpose: Computes minimum marks required in end-semester exams to pass a subject or hit a target grade given internal assessment marks.

### 6. Backlog Planner
- URL: https://flunked.online/tools/backlog-planner
- Purpose: Multi-semester supplementary clearance roadmap without breaching university year-back rules.

### 7. What Tier Engineer Are You?
- URL: https://flunked.online/tools/tier-engineer
- Purpose: Realistic skills auditor scoring DSA, projects, system design, and open-source contributions to evaluate placement competitiveness.

### 8. Hostel Expense Splitter
- URL: https://flunked.online/tools/expense-splitter
- Purpose: Minimizes transactions and settles roommate expenses (groceries, food deliveries, Wi-Fi, electricity) without awkward confrontations.

### 9. Is This Stipend Good?
- URL: https://flunked.online/tools/stipend-checker
- Purpose: Analyzes internship stipends against real living expenses in Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Gurgaon, Mumbai, and Noida.

### 10. Grade Required to Pass
- URL: https://flunked.online/tools/grade-to-pass
- Purpose: Instant passing threshold calculator for relative and absolute grading scales.

### 11. Sleep Debt Calculator
- URL: https://flunked.online/tools/sleep-debt
- Purpose: Quantifies cumulative college sleep deprivation and recovery timelines.

### 12. Placement Readiness Quiz
- URL: https://flunked.online/tools/placement-quiz
- Purpose: Diagnostic assessment identifying specific weaknesses across DSA, CS Fundamentals, Resume, and Behavioral rounds.

### 13. Which Startup Should You Build?
- URL: https://flunked.online/tools/startup-match
- Purpose: Branch, CGPA, and chaos tolerance mapped to tailored college startup concepts.

### 14. Mess Food Calorie Estimator
- URL: https://flunked.online/tools/mess-calories
- Purpose: Nutritional and caloric estimator tailored to Indian hostel and canteen menus (paneer bhurji, dal tadka, roti, maggi).

### 15. LinkedIn Bio Auditor
- URL: https://flunked.online/tools/linkedin-auditor
- Purpose: Rates student LinkedIn headlines and bios, weeding out overused corporate cliches.

### 16. Should I Attend This Lecture?
- URL: https://flunked.online/tools/attend-or-skip
- Purpose: Real-time morning decision engine evaluating professor strictness, attendance margin, and sleep levels.

### 17. Assignment Panic Calculator
- URL: https://flunked.online/tools/assignment-panic
- Purpose: Calculates submission feasibility when facing urgent deadlines and predicts extension likelihood.

### 18. How Indian College Student Are You?
- URL: https://flunked.online/tools/how-indian-are-you
- Purpose: Cultural benchmark score based on common engineering and degree college habits.

### 19. CGPA → Marriage Prospects
- URL: https://flunked.online/tools/cgpa-marriage
- Purpose: Satirical calculator projecting matrimonial biodata impressiveness based on engineering grades and campus pedigree.
